scene: After-dinner living room. Dad sits in his armchair at screen-left; Child stands facing him at screen-right, both with empty hands. A closed work bag rests on the floor beside the chair and stays closed. Locked 16:9 medium two-shot with both faces visible; the story is told with small hand gestures only.

emotion.baseline: Calm, warm and regulated baseline. Both speak at a normal family volume with small, natural facial movements and gestures.
emotion.allowed_shift: Child shows brief curiosity and quiet amusement while asking for more of the story; Dad tells it warmly with small gestures; both end with gentle smiles.
emotion.forbidden: No exaggerated surprise, wide-eyed shock, bouncing, raised voices, impatience, blaming or teasing. Any disappointment, worry or sadness stays mild and brief, and the adult helps things stay steady.

clips.start: Dad sits in the armchair with hands on his knees; Child stands facing him with empty hands; the closed bag rests on the floor beside the chair.
clips.action: Dad opens the story with one small storytelling gesture. Child leans in slightly and asks to hear everything, moving only his hands while speaking.
clips.end: Dad sits with one hand on the armrest; Child stands attentively with empty hands; the bag stays closed on the floor.

clips.start: Dad sits with one hand on the armrest; Child stands attentively with empty hands.
clips.action: Dad mimes opening a bag with both hands, then pats an imaginary hat on his head. Child tilts his head with mild surprise and asks what Dad found, keeping his hands near his chest.
clips.end: Dad keeps one hand lightly on top of his head; Child waits with empty hands, leaning in.

clips.start: Dad keeps one hand lightly on top of his head; Child waits with empty hands, leaning in.
clips.action: Dad lifts an imaginary sandwich from his head with two fingers and sets it down with a smile. Child covers a small laugh with one hand, asks his final questions, and ends with a friendly pointing gesture toward Dad's head.
clips.end: Both share a gentle smile; Dad's hands rest on his knees; Child's hands return to his sides; the bag remains closed on the floor.
